root_cause.summary: Powerhouse incorrectly treated LinkedIn organization/readback 401/403 responses after a successful company-post create as evidence that publication had failed. The provider had already returned a durable post URN and the post was visibly live.
causes: write capability and readback/admin capability were conflated
provider_truth_verified was used as the publication state instead of provider_create_success plus durable post URN
the watchdog could downgrade an already-created provider side effect because exact API readback was permission-limited

prevention_rules: Provider create success plus a durable external post ID is authoritative evidence that the provider side effect exists.
Persist the provider ID immediately and set republish_forbidden=true.
Never downgrade a provider-created LinkedIn company post to failed or blocked solely because GET_POST_CONTENT or GET_COMPANY_INFO returns 401/403.
Close the daily publication obligation as PUBLISHED on provider create acknowledgement; exact readback is optional verification enrichment.
Reconcile the exact existing provider ID only; never create a replacement post.
User-visible public-page evidence may close provider truth when API readback is permission-limited.
Do not request repeated OAuth reconnection merely to verify an already-created post.

outcome.intended_state: Daily LinkedIn company publications remain published after provider acknowledgement even when exact API readback is permission-limited, with no duplicate retries or unnecessary reconnect loops.
